test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_loss_classification.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/paper/loss_classification.py tests/test_loss_classification.py

implemented: Supports the eight requested evidence-linked reason categories and explicit UNKNOWN when a losing trade has no evidence identifiers.
Preserves one or more category/evidence-ID pairs and produces deterministic output.
Labels non-loss rows NOT_A_LOSS rather than assigning a loss cause.
Persists classifications in DuckDB with deterministic identity, idempotent replays, and conflict rejection for retroactive edits.
Revalidates persisted result contents against their evidence before writing.
blockers: Evidence IDs are caller-provided and are not resolved against a trusted immutable evidence registry.
Classifier is not yet integrated into the canonical paper trade ledger or loss-review report.
Categories do not establish causal root cause; independent review and supporting data remain required.
